title: Structured knowledge preservation
content: Pausa AI migration must preserve history, stable IDs, prompts, decisions, commands, architecture, links, files, pending work and relationships for humans and future AI/indexing.

title: Layered knowledge architecture
content: Knowledge is organized as sanitized RAW, forensic extraction, canonical dossier, structured import packs, master KB, prompt library, per-project current state, archive and sanitized logs.

title: Preserve conflicts and lifecycle states
content: Do not silently resolve conflicts or discard historical versions; distinguish current, historical, superseded, abandoned and unknown information.

title: Public repository requires sanitization
content: Raw chat preservation is subordinate to repository security: never commit secrets, tokens, cookies, passwords, private dumps, unnecessary PII or identifiable wellbeing/health histories.

title: Pausa AI product scope
content: Pausa AI is a preventive wellness full-stack MVP. The visible current priority is the mobile-oriented B2C core: authentication, onboarding, dashboard, check-in, lightweight exercises, Body & Movement/Yoga, history and profile.

title: Existing hardening baseline
content: Repository hardening tests cover rate limiting, session revocation, data-subject export/deletion, privacy guards, secure media registration, security headers, accessibility baselines and health monitoring.

title: Production readiness remains incomplete
content: Managed PostgreSQL, HTTPS staging, production secret management, real transactional email, monitoring, backup/restore, rollback, legal LGPD review and safe mobile release remain production gates.

title: Remote automation added in migration branch
content: The migration branch adds CI, CodeQL, Dependabot, CODEOWNERS, a pull request security checklist and a safe bug-report template.

title: Older private chat is not externally retrievable
content: The provided ChatGPT /c/ URL cannot be externally fetched, so exact transcript migration must remain partial until an accessible share/export is supplied.

title: Main branch unprotected at audit time
content: GitHub branch metadata reported main as unprotected. Branch protection or a ruleset should require pull requests and successful CI checks.
